text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking along the 
riverbank, I spotted a Tracen Academy 
student hard at work training her heart 
out.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Phew! Five more sets of hill dashes...! 
Once those are done, head back to the 
academy, and—
choice_data_list: You're really giving it your all.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Tomorrow is the mock race! I 
won't accept any compromises if I want to 
seize 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Besides—winning is important, of course, 
but there are things that matter even more 
than that!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
To run in a way that's thrilling and full 
of burning passion!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Because I am―― the "protagonist"!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
To make races—to make the story that is me 
exciting! To move everyone's hearts and 
make them tremble with emotion! That is my 
mission!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Allllriiiiight!! Let's do thissssss!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I didn't fully understand it, but she 
was brimming with intense passion. 
Curious, I decided to go watch her mock 
race the following day.

text_block_list.name: Spectating Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, Number 15 broke away, did she? But 
Numbers 4 and 14 are holding their ground. 
This is—

text_block_list.name: Spectating Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, hold on! From mid-pack, on the 
outside―― someone is surging up?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Urrrggghhh!! Burn, legs, buuurn!!!!

text_block_list.name: Spectating Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What is that running form?! It's 
like――a blazing pinwheel of raw power!

text_block_list.name: Spectating Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
She's broken away completely!! One length! 
Two lengths!! And now――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so—with a dramatic late charge, Kiseki 
brilliantly seized first place!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...! I... I won...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
――So, how was that race?! Pretty exciting, 
wasn't it?!
choice_data_list: Your run truly shone, even in the rain.

The speed of that late surge showed all 
your hard work!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Gh... right?! Pushing forward relentlessly 
through the foul weather! Who is that?! 
Closing in! Passing them—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That very moment! I was totally the "main 
character", wasn't I!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If it's okay with you, please keep 
watching! Watch how the story that is 'me' 
unfolds!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Training montage straight into 
victory! Now that's the classic "main 
character" storyline!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It went exactly as planned this time...! 
What kind of fiery development should I 
cook up next...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, inspiration is bubbling up endlessly! 
Well then, look forward to next time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—It seems I won't be able to take my eyes 
off the serialized tale of "Kiseki" 
anytime soon.
